summary: SuperX AI Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing two material events: (1) a convertible note and warrant subscription agreement with Mercuria Holdings for $26.895M aggregate principal, convertible at $8.15/share with a 12-month maturity and SOFR+2.2% interest; and (2) a strategic partnership with Mercuria Asia to jointly develop AI data center infrastructure in Southeast and Central Asia. The filing is a routine disclosure of financing and partnership arrangements, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative corporate action. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics involving a change of control are present. There is no risk-arb angle as this is a standard capital-raising and collaboration announcement.
